claim_audit: The $250K price point is not a universal property or household. Toledo/Rochester figures need a dated city/metro/property-type series; average and median differ. Rounded national household income $84K is broadly consistent with Census2024 $83,730 available before publication. SCF2022 $8K transaction-account median is dated, conditional on holders and broader than a savings account, not a current national down-payment balance. Dad1988 $87K/$35K is an unverified personal anecdote;2.486x and2.5x$84K=$210K arithmetic works, but interest rates, taxes, size and local terms are omitted.

20%of250K=$50K;10%=$25K and a225Kloan reproduce. At8,400saving/year, reaching50K fromzero takes5.952years, broadlysix; if the preceding8Kbalance is available, the42Kgap takesfive, notsix, beforeinterest/housepricechanges. Almost nobody saves10%gross needs data and a defined population. Closing fees, prepaid expenses, reserves and moving costs are not included in these down-payment figures.

The stored text first says3%FHA, then3.5%FHA=$8,250. HUD says FHA down payments can be as low as3.5%subject to eligibility;3.5%of250K=$8,750, not8,250. Conventional3%products and FHA3.5%are different. FHA mortgage insurance is not conventional PMI; upfront/ongoing premiums and cancellation/duration rules differ. CFPB confirms conventional PMI protects lender and can enable lower-down-payment access. Calling it solely a bouncer cover charge omits the access tradeoff;60-150quote depends on credit,term,coverage andprice.

Under an analyst-specified30-year level-payment convention,225K at6% gives1,348.99P&I/month and7% gives1,496.93. The source1,250-1,500range needs a different lower-rate/term assumption at its bottom; loan term is not clearly specified in the stored text. It later uses1,550without a new rate/term. Propertytax1%-1.5%gives208.33-312.50monthly, close210-315;insurance800-1500annual gives66.67-125monthly, close65-125;maintenance1%=2,500/year=208.33monthly is arithmetic, not adequate reserve proof.

The explicit cost components1,550+260+95+208+100 total2,213monthly/26,556annual. Stored narration then gives1,813,2,813,25,333.50annual,2,130,2,113 and later2,613, plus malformed2.1 13. These cannot all describe one unchanged model. Original audio is unverified; potential ASR/transcription errors are preserved, not silently corrected into one intended total. A cost table must identify which inputs changed. At2,213monthly,28%gross needs94,843annual;43%needs61,758 assuming no other qualifying debt.

The claimed90.5K/59K thresholds instead approximately fit2,113monthly:90,557/58,967.28%housing and43%TOTALdebt are different denominators; the latter is not a comfort guarantee and must include car/student/card obligations. CFPB GeneralQM amendment replaced its43%cap with price-based thresholds, so banks approve under43 is not universal law. Maintenance may be a household cash reserve rather than underwriting housing debt. The source switches between comfort, qualification and gross/net ratios without a single reconciled definition.

Smiths4,400net minus2,113housing=2,287 is correct. Listed other costs350+120+200+250+150+500=1,570 leave717, not778.2,113/4,400=48.02%, supporting48%net, whereas the explicit2,213sum would be50.3%.75Kgross to4,400net needs state,filing,benefits and401kcontribution assumptions; no payroll calculation provided. Remaining700is a personal margin after selected expenses, not a universal crisis threshold. Missing utilities/phones/repairs/reserves matter; prescribed retirement withholding already saves something, contradicting literal nothing saved if interpreted universally.

40%-50%households uncomfortable at250K and80%pricedout at500K require a model, down payment,rate,debts,region and definition; not derived from a median alone.400%homepricegrowth since1990 versus180%income needs matched series/endpoints and nominal/real/household units. It does not prove math never worked or no household can buy; the script itself identifies feasible earners/regions. Rent/investthe difference also needs actual comparable rent, investmentrisk,fees,tax,transitioncost and household preference.

Taxes and insurance can rise, but every year forever is not a guaranteed trajectory.1%maintenance is a heuristic; older-house replacement costs need item-specific life/cost estimates and may not scale linearly with value. Stored water-heater replacement around200is unverified and possibly missing digits; originalaudio not checked. The opening says paneling definitely contains asbestos from appearance; EPA says visual appearance alone cannot establish asbestos, requiring appropriate professional assessment/testing. Do not convert comedic certainty into a verified defect of a real house.

The Smiths/jobloss/repair sequence is illustrative, not a verified longitudinal default case or causal estimate. Income, childcare, credit balances, interest, alternative housing and reserves are absent. Approval is not proof of comfort, but it is also not evidence every agent/bank profits without risk. Owning with a mortgage still involves assets and debt, not zero ownership or networth by definition. Selling can involve fees/losses but is not automatically equivalent to abandoning payments and destroyingcredit. Structural explanations and individual choices can interact; the video does not identify their causal shares.
